input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: The only TrueLink warranty in the Agreement (Section 9) is a Y2K date-processing warranty; Section 3 Hosting Services and Section 4 Support Services impose only "reasonable commercial efforts" standards, and Section 2 contains no conformance warranty for the licensed Interface. There is therefore no software-to-documentation warranty, no services warranty period, and no repair/replace/refund remedy, so the clause fails every fallback element (the general disclaimer at p0076 is at least limited to "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT", so it does not need a further carve-out). We insert the fallback warranty (90 days software conformance, 30 days services) with repair, replacement or refund at Client's election, targeting the fallback level rather than the 12-month preferred position.

proposal.summary: Insert a TrueLink performance/conformance warranty with repair, replacement or refund remedy in Section 9.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only a Y2K warranty, so TrueLink stands behind neither the software's conformance to its documentation nor the Hosting and Support Services. We have added our fallback warranty position: 90 days for the software, 30 days for the services, with repair or replacement or a refund of the fees paid.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that (i) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation, and (ii) for a period of thirty (30) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will conform in all material respects to the requirements of this Agreement. For any breach of this warranty, TrueLink will, at Client's election, repair or replace the non-conforming software or Services or refund the fees paid for the non-conforming software or Services.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
